messages:
jess: Deploy finished for release r2026.03.21 (canary→prod). Starting post-deploy smoke. Change window until 22:00 UTC. Observability: watch kv-warmup and embed routes.

deploy-bot: Deploy r2026.03.21 -> prod complete. Duration: 6m12s. Canary passed.

mike: running synth probes now, sampling 2% tail traffic to synthetic harness.

anya: noted. I'll watch p95 and kvcache hitrate. tagging @sre-oncall

sre-oncall: on it. will watch infra metrics + router 5xx.

mike: first batch of synths: embed-route p95 +120ms vs baseline, overall okay, small jitter. sending logs:
```
SYNTH: embed_route /v1/embeds p95=160ms baseline=45ms errors=0
KV_WARMUP: prefill_rate=0.6 hit=0.82
```

jess: 160ms p95 is higher than expected. Is this just cold starts on dedicated pools?

anya: looks like a few new hosts had kv-cache missing. hit jumps from .92->.82 when fanout occurs. we have a warmup policy that's not fully covering staggered nodes.

mike: quick proposal: increase synth sampling to 10% for next 2 minutes and prefill headers with x-warmup=true to trigger prefill path. rollback if errors >0.5% or p95 > 2x baseline

sre-oncall: agreed. set sampling=10% and watch for 5xx. I'll open a temporary pin if we need to roll back.

deploy-bot: Sampling changed: synth_sampling=10% by mike at 6732104380

mike: increased sampling. running.

anya: after ramp, probe p95 settled ~80ms over baseline, kv_hit recovered to 0.9. no 5xx. getting traces: appears router sharding with new host caused initial cache misses.

jess: OK looks healthy. decision: continue rollout, but add a postdeploy task to adjust prefill window for the next release. I'll file release note: "adjust prefill hysteresis for staggered TPU pools". :memo:

mike: filing note and creating a canary-pin in case of regression. pin id: pin-20260321-1

sre-oncall: leaving minor alerting increase for next hour to catch regressions. reverting to baseline sampling after 2m.

deploy-bot: Sampling reverted to 2% by mike at 6732104460

jess: thanks team. marking thread resolved unless we see new alerts. :thumbsup:
